name: Seven Card Stud
tagline: No board: four of your seven cards are face up for all to read.
rulesSummary: Everyone antes and gets two cards face down and one face up. The lowest card showing must bring it in for half the smallest bet (ties go by suit: clubs lowest, then diamonds, hearts, spades).
Fourth, fifth and sixth street: one more card face up to each player still in, then a round of betting. Seventh street: a last card face down, and a final round.
From fourth street on, the best hand showing bets first. No limit: you can go all in at any time.
At the showdown, the best five of your seven cards wins the pot. Ties split it.
